Configuration¶

RSL-RL is configured with a dictionary that is passed to RSL-RL’s runner during initialization. The dictionary is usually read from a YAML file or constructed from Python dataclasses, such as in Isaac Lab. It is nested to reflect the structure of the library, and follows this pattern:(RSL-RL 使用一个字典进行配置，该字典在初始化时传递给 RSL-RL 的运行器。这个字典通常从 YAML 文件读取，或者从 Python 数据类（例如在 Isaac Lab 中）构建。该字典是嵌套的，用以反映库的结构，并遵循以下模式：)

The top level represents the runner configuration, which is composed of general settings and configuration dictionaries for the algorithm (e.g. PPO), as well as for the models used by the algorithm (e.g. actor and critic). The algorithm dictionary contains the parameters of the algorithm, and may contain one or more configuration dictionaries for extensions. The model dictionaries contain the parameters of the models, and may contain a configuration dictionary for a distribution.(顶层表示运行器配置，由通用设置以及算法（例如 PPO）和算法使用的模型（例如策略网络和价值网络）的配置字典组成。算法字典包含算法的参数，并可能包含一个或多个扩展的配置字典。模型字典包含模型的参数，并可能包含一个分布的配置字典。)

In the following sections, we list the available settings for each configuration component, provide a minimal example configuration in YAML format, and explain how observations are configured.(在以下部分中，我们将列出每个配置组件的可用设置，提供一个最小的 YAML 格式示例配置，并解释如何 配置观测值。)

Model Configuration¶

Different algorithms use models for different purposes. For example, PPO uses an actor and a critic, while Distillation uses a student and a teacher. Even though their function might be different, they can all use the same underlying model classes. RSL-RL currently implements three different models: MLPModel, RNNModel, and CNNModel, which are configured as follows.(不同的算法将模型用于不同的目的。例如，PPO 使用策略网络和价值网络，而 Distillation 使用学生网络和教师网络。尽管它们的功能可能不同，但都可以使用相同的底层模型类。RSL-RL 目前实现了三种不同的模型：MLPModel、RNNModel 和 CNNModel，它们的配置如下。)

Hidden dimensions of the MLP.(MLP 的隐藏层维度。)

None

Optional output distribution configuration. If provided, the model can output stochastic values sampled from the distribution.(可选的输出分布配置。如果提供，模型可以输出从该分布中采样的随机值。)

The distribution_cfg dictionary contains all parameters required by a specific distribution. RSL-RL implements two distributions by default: A simple Gaussian distribution (GaussianDistribution) and a Gaussian distribution with state-dependent standard deviation (HeteroscedasticGaussianDistribution). Both require the same parameters:(distribution_cfg 字典包含了特定分布所需的所有参数。RSL-RL 默认实现了两种分布：简单高斯分布 (GaussianDistribution) 和状态相关标准差的高斯分布 (HeteroscedasticGaussianDistribution)。两者都需要相同的参数：)

CNNModel¶

The CNNModel inherits from the MLPModel and thus shares the same configuration keys as the MLPModel, with the addition of the following keys:(CNNModel 继承自 MLPModel，因此与 MLPModel 共享相同的配置键，并增加了以下键：)

None

Key

Type

Default

Description

class_name

str

required

Model class name. Valid values: "CNNModel".(模型类名。有效值："CNNModel"。)

…

…

…

…

cnn_cfg

dict[str, dict] | dict[str, Any] | None

Configuration of the CNN encoder(s).(CNN 编码器的配置。)

Instead of directly passing the CNN parameters to the CNNModel (similar to how it is done for the MLPModel and RNNModel), the parameters are grouped in a dictionary cnn_cfg. This enables passing multiple CNN configurations for different observations (e.g. different cameras). If only one CNN is needed or all CNNs have the same configuration, the dictionary may directly contain the CNN parameters. If multiple CNNs with different configurations are needed, the dictionary must contain a dictionary for each CNN configuration, with the key being the observation the configuration applies to. The CNNModel will then create CNNs based on the provided configurations. A CNN configuration includes the following parameters:(与将 CNN 参数直接传递给 CNNModel（类似于 MLPModel 和 RNNModel 的方式）不同，参数被分组在一个字典 cnn_cfg 中。这允许为不同的观测（例如不同的相机）传递多个 CNN 配置。如果只需要一个 CNN 或者所有 CNN 具有相同的配置，该字典可以直接包含 CNN 参数。如果需要多个具有不同配置的 CNN，该字典必须为每个 CNN 配置包含一个字典，键为该配置适用的观测。然后，CNNModel 将根据提供的配置创建 CNN。一个 CNN 配置包含以下参数：)

Example Configuration¶

While the previous sections make it seem rather complicated to set up a configuration, the required configuration to run a training with, e.g., PPO is actually quite simple. The following configuration is already sufficient:(尽管前面的部分让配置看起来相当复杂，但运行例如 PPO 训练所需的配置实际上相当简单。以下配置已经足够：)

runner:
  num_steps_per_env: 24
  obs_groups: {"actor": ["policy"], "critic": ["policy", "privileged"]}
  save_interval: 100
  algorithm:
    class_name: PPO
  actor:
    class_name: MLPModel
    distribution_cfg:
      class_name: GaussianDistribution
  critic:
    class_name: MLPModel

Observation Configuration¶

RSL-RL expects the step() method of the environment to return observations as a TensorDict. This dictionary contains one or more tensors with observation data, referred to as observation groups in RSL-RL and Isaac Lab.(RSL-RL 期望环境的 step() 方法返回的观测值是一个 TensorDict。该字典包含一个或多个带有观测数据的张量，在 RSL-RL 和 Isaac Lab 中被称为观测组。)

The obs_groups dictionary of the runner configuration defines which observation groups are used for which purpose. Each purpose defines its own observation set, which is simply a list of observation groups. In other words, the obs_groups dictionary maps from observation sets to lists of observation groups.(运行器配置 中的 obs_groups 字典定义了哪些观测组用于哪些目的。每个目的定义了自己的观测集，它只是一个观测组的列表。换句话说，obs_groups 字典将观测集映射到观测组的列表。)

As the above definition is quite abstract, let’s consider a simple example for a PPO training. The step() method of our environment might return the following observations:(由于上述定义相当抽象，让我们考虑一个 PPO 训练的简单示例。我们环境的 step() 方法可能返回以下观测值：)

obs = TensorDict(
  {
    "policy": torch.tensor([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]), # available during robot deployment
    "privileged": torch.tensor([4.0, 5.0, 6.0]), # only available during training
  }
)

Let’s assume the “policy” observation group is meant for both actor and critic. The “privileged” observation group is only available during training and therefore cannot be used by the actor model, but may still improve learning performance when passed to the critic. Thus, the obs_groups dictionary would be configured as follows:(假设“policy”观测组是用于策略网络和价值网络的。“privileged”观测组仅在训练期间可用，因此不能被策略模型使用，但当传递给价值网络时仍可能提高学习性能。因此，obs_groups 字典将如下配置：)

obs_groups: {"actor": ["policy"], "critic": ["policy", "privileged"]}

With this configuration, the actor would receive the “policy” tensor as input, while the critic would receive both the “policy” and the “privileged” tensor as input.(使用此配置，策略网络将接收“policy”张量作为输入，而价值网络将同时接收“policy”和“privileged”张量作为输入。)

Depending on the algorithm and extensions used, RSL-RL expects different observation sets to be present in the obs_groups dictionary. Currently, the following observation sets may be required, depending on the configuration:(根据所使用的算法和扩展，RSL-RL 期望 obs_groups 字典中存在不同的观测集。目前，根据配置，可能需要以下观测集：)

Key

Description

actor

Observations used as input to the actor model.(用作策略模型输入的观测值。)

critic

Observations used as input to the critic model.(用作价值模型输入的观测值。)

student

Observations used as input to the student model.(用作学生模型输入的观测值。)

teacher

Observations used as input to the teacher model.(用作教师模型输入的观测值。)

rnd_state

Observations used as input to the RND extension.(用作 RND 扩展输入的观测值。)

Incomplete or incorrect configurations are handled in resolve_obs_groups(), which provides detailed information on how errors are resolved.(不完整或不正确的配置在 resolve_obs_groups() 中处理，该函数提供了关于如何解决错误的详细信息。)
